description: The PR set out to stop records flipping between full and incremental runs. The reviewer confirmed with a warehouse query that ties on the sort key still flip (9 records), then posted it as a medium note because most look old and the impact is likely small. A defect a data query confirms is verified, and estimated impact never lowers it.

findings.title: Ties on the sort key still flip between runs
findings.body: ROW_NUMBER() orders by updated_at only. A warehouse query found 9 records with two rows on the same updated_at; full and incremental runs pick different ones. Most look old, so the impact is likely small.
